rationale: The agent authenticated the user via name and ZIP lookup, but failed multiple key requirements: (1) It performed order-changing writes (exchange, return, and cancellation) without explicit user confirmation. (2) It appears to have both exchanged and returned the same tablet item in order #W2692684, which is contradictory and likely incorrect. (3) It canceled the charger order (#W9373487) seemingly regardless of whether the tablet was actually returned, contrary to the user’s conditional request. (4) It initiated a sneaker return (#W7449508) without confirmation and without providing next steps. (5) It did not provide the requested tracking number despite fetching order details. (6) It did not respect the user’s preference to do one thing at a time. Given these issues, the request was not completed in line with policy.
